'''2010 US West Nationals Day 1 Cory Degroot LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Cory Degroot]] at [[2010 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Corey DeGroot
* '''Deck name:''' WYS
* '''Username:''' OOt
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
